keyboard.when: submitOn is enter and no composition is in progress
keyboard.effect: requests a submit with reason keyboard
inserts a line break, the platform's behaviour
requests a submit with reason keyboard

emphasis.ring: the binding draws two aria-hidden marks, ring and glow, and writes data-emphasis=ring: the ring is a band of --slotted-prompt-composer-ring-width cut from a conic gradient of --slotted-prompt-composer-ring-colors (data slots 1, 3, 5, 2), the glow the same gradient on a box the frame's size, blurred by half of --slotted-prompt-composer-ring-glow-reach under the frame's surface (restated on the root's ::after), so its halo fades past the edge and adds no overflow to a scrolling ancestor, at --slotted-prompt-composer-ring-glow-opacity at rest, -focus while the input holds focus, -busy while loading, submitted or streaming; each turns by a transform over --slotted-prompt-composer-ring-duration (duration-loop-slow) at constant speed. The ring replaces the frame's border, focus outline and raised shadow; the controls keep their own focus rings. Reduced motion stops the turn; forced colours remove both marks and bring back the border and the outline

dictate.engine: @slotted/core/dictation over the platform's SpeechRecognition (webkitSpeechRecognition in Chrome and Safari), continuous, without interim results
dictate.lang: the lang prop, else the nearest lang attribute
dictate.writes: each event's final phrases at the end of the value, one space between, as a value request with reason dictation
dictate.pressed: aria-pressed while the engine listens; a second press stops it; the name stays dictate
dictate.absent: without a recognition engine React renders nothing and Angular hides the button
